key.name: border-thickness
key.description: Thickness of the border around always-on-top windows (in pixels)

key.name: use-accent-color
key.description: When enabled on GNOME 47+, the border uses the desktop accent colour. Falls back to the custom border colour on older GNOME versions or when this option is turned off.

key.name: border-color
key.description: Border color in hex format (#rrggbb). Used when "Use system accent color" is off or unavailable.

key.name: corner-radius
key.description: Corner radius of the border in pixels.

key.name: toggle-always-on-top
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that pins or unpins the focused window. Empty to disable.

key.name: show-panel-button
key.description: Show a button in the top bar that pins or unpins the focused window when clicked.

key.name: panel-button-position
key.description: Which part of the top bar the button is placed in.

key.name: panel-button-index
key.description: Order of the button among the other items in its part of the top bar; 0 is first.

key.name: stick-pinned-windows
key.summary: Show pinned windows on all workspaces
key.description: When enabled, a window is also placed on all workspaces while it is always-on-top.
